newsitem.title: USA: Zapata to seek Envirodyne board seats.
newsitem.headline: Zapata to seek Envirodyne board seats.

text.p: Zapata Corp said Friday it has filed preliminary proxy materials in opposition to Envirodyne Industries Inc's board of directors.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Zapata said it is nominating Malcolm Glazer, Avram Glazer and Robert Leffler for election to Envirodyne's board.

The Glazer group, through Zapata, said it is proposing in the proxy that the number of Envirodyne board members be reduced to five from seven. The group is also recommeding that the company take appropiate action to redeem as soon as practicable the rights issued under an agreement with Harris Trust & Savings.

Oak Brook, Ill.,-based Envirodyne earlier this month said it will vigorously oppose efforts by the Glazer group to replace all of its directors. Malcolm Glazer and his son Avram currently serve on Envirodyne's board, although they were not slated for reelection after Malcolm Glazer refused to agree not to seek control of the company for the next 12 months.
